# Echo Clone — Expressive AI Voice & Multi-Emotion TTS Studio
URL: https://echoclonevoice.vercel.app/

## Overview
Echo Clone is a multi-accent, multi-emotion AI Text-to-Speech (TTS) studio designed for storytellers, content creators, audiobook narrators, educators, and marketers.

## Key Capabilities
- **Regional Country Accents**: American English (US), British English (UK), Australian English (AU), Canadian English (CA), South Asian English (PK/IN), and Urdu / English Bilingual delivery.
- **Automatic Multi-Emotion Story Mode**: Analyzes scripts sentence by sentence and shifts vocal expression across Calm, Angry/Intense, Laughing/Joyful, Humorous/Playful, Sad/Emotional, Excited/Energetic, and Whispering/Suspense.
- **Delivery Modes**: Story Narration, Public Speech / Keynote, Professional / Corporate, Conversational / Podcast, Dramatic / Cinema Trailer, and Standard Clear Read.
- **Zero External Keys Required**: Built-in neural TTS synthesis with seamless expressive browser speech fallback and instant WAV export.
- **Synced Creator Packages**:
  - Starter Free ($0 / 30 days): 10,000 monthly characters, US & UK accents.
  - Creator Pro ($9 / 30 days): 150,000 monthly characters, all 6 accents, Auto Multi-Emotion Story Mode.
  - Studio Enterprise ($24 / 30 days): 500,000 monthly characters, long-form 15,000-character scripts, priority support.
